pr_body:
When merging plain lists we shouldn't cast them to `List<Map<String, V>>. If we do that we get a `ClassCastException` in runtime during iteration, e.g. if the list contains strings, not maps.

This issue has been already fixed in 8.0 during one of the refactorings, but it hasn't been fixed in 7.x.

Fixes #78211

review_comment: Since these are exactly the same strings, it's difficult to tell whether the merging actually happened in the right order from this test. Could you change one of the formats?
:+1: This test verified the behaviour from the SDH ticket where `XContentHelper` threw an exception on the same strings. I will add another test with different formats.
